pairs.subject: generated-music-acceptance
pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/audio/_insight/Rubric.tsx:4 The scoring sheet that the strengths and lessons sections aggregate is a 1-10 taste rubric (melody, instrument quality, sound quality), not a pass/fail/unmeasured checklist derived from the brief's word commitments, so acceptance evidence drifts into taste; only tempo, key and length are held against the brief.

techniques.evidence: app/(studio)/audio/_insight/Rubric.tsx:4 Takes are scored 1-10 on taste dimensions (packages/ui rubric.ts DIM: melody, instrument_quality, sound_quality). Nothing turns the brief's words (named instruments, the negative/exclude list, mood) into pass/fail/unmeasured items.

app/(studio)/audio/_insight/read.ts:114 The requested tempo, key and duration are checked with a tool against the ingest measure of the bytes. The result is held, missed, octave, unmeasured or unasked, and unmeasured is never rounded to pass. This is partial: section-boundary offsets and the shape of the ending are not checked, even though takes carry a plan.

pairs.subject: generated-music-acceptance
pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/audio/_audio/Arrange.tsx:236 Finalizing a take onto the library shelf (which pipeline/sound.mts `finalized` serves to agents) is admitted on a library label alone: no loudness or true-peak check and no rights/provenance record gate it, so an unmeasured, uncleared file can be finalized.

techniques.evidence: app/(studio)/audio/_audio/arrangeRead.ts:70 The card reads the ingest measure for peaks and length only. Integrated loudness and true peak never reach the board, and finalize does not check them (checkMove refuses only needs-label).

app/(studio)/audio/return/route.ts:69 A file brought back by hand from Suno is saved as the next version, and can arrive already finalized. No account, plan tier, terms or cleared destination is recorded; the SoundTake type has no such fields.
